subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The school cafeteria changed its menu.”?
options: It said Friday instead of Thursday.
They said healthy food was boring.
A student said, "Food is like a map of life."
At first, they only shared food.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It said Friday instead of Thursday.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They said healthy food was boring.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A student said, 'Food is like a map of life.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「At first, they only shared food.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They said healthy food was boring.」，答案為「They said healthy food was boring.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They said healthy food was boring.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
